why: Does a crowd hold together the way its pairs say? The 4D force fields as first fitted collapse into crystals four times too dense; a polarizable model with 4D's cloud terms halves that but still packs densely. Trimers cut from those crystals (and one from our water's ice, the calibration), their Hartree-Fock energies whole and in every part, so the three-body term the polarizable model predicts can be checked. One trimer per runner (a few GB each). Queued behind corr-4.
